# Zuoyu Garment

> Denim OEM/ODM manufacturer based in Dayong, Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. Custom jeans, denim jackets, denim skirts and denim dresses for brand owners and importers in Europe and North America. Minimum order {{MOQ}} pieces per style per colour. Samples in {{SAMPLE_LEAD}} days, bulk in {{PROD_LEAD}} days, FOB {{FOB_PORT}}. SMETA audited (Sedex reference ZAA600231250), US CPSIA GCC (BYT26080342) and RoHS (MTL24120600306R01). Does not hold OEKO-TEX, GRS, amfori BSCI or ISO 9001 and does not claim them.

## Products
- [Jeans](https://zuoyugarment.com/jeans/): five-pocket, straight, slim, relaxed, wide-leg and utility jeans in rigid, comfort-stretch and high-stretch denim. From {{PRICE_JEANS}} per piece.
- [Denim jackets and skirts](https://zuoyugarment.com/denim-jackets-and-skirts/): trucker, overshirt, chore jackets and denim skirts, including coordinated sets. From {{PRICE_JACKETS}}.
- [Denim dresses](https://zuoyugarment.com/denim-dresses/): shirt dresses, pinafores, slip-bib and tailored denim dresses. From {{PRICE_DRESSES}}.
